description: Medical negligence dispute between patient and clinic
party_a_statement: I went to Dr Mehta's clinic in January 2026 for a knee surgery. After the surgery my condition got worse and I developed an infection. I had to be admitted to another hospital for 3 weeks and spent 120000 INR on additional treatment. The clinic never warned me about infection risks and I was not given proper post-operative care instructions. I want full reimbursement of my additional medical expenses.
party_b_statement: The surgery was performed correctly and in line with standard medical practice. The patient was given post-operative care instructions both verbally and in writing. The infection developed due to the patient not following the care instructions — he did not clean the wound as advised and returned to physical work within 3 days of surgery against our explicit advice. We have signed consent forms and discharge notes. We are not liable for patient non-compliance.
